training.canonical: minimum validation loss; tie by maximum validation AUROC, then seed
training.device: CPU fallback; not bitwise reproduction of the original GPU run

explanation.additional_cases: original deterministic selection on fresh predictions, descriptive only
explanation.ig: 64 trapezoidal intervals, fixed predicted logit, standardized zero baseline; independent batched calculation and public native IG
explanation.occlusion: 240 signed calibrated probability differences, 0.5 s cells, 20 random controls
explanation.compare: diagnostic D_XAI distinct from system Gamma

review.scope: lightweight public SystemEvidence route (full local maps not repeated for entire cohort)
review.policy: highest rho first; fixed tie by ecg_id; compare same floor(0.20*n) records
metrics: patient-cluster paired bootstrap CI for difference in captured errors
review.limitation: retrospective selection with known reference labels, no actual clinician behavior or treatment outcomes; prior test partition already publicly examined, so exploratory rather than novel confirmatory evidence
